# Omega X Converter

> Universal unit conversion platform with 35 physical categories, deterministic conversion algorithms, offline PWA capabilities, and authoritative scientific standards alignment.

Omega X Converter is a client-side unit conversion web application developed and published by NumanX Studio. It provides exact, deterministic conversions across length, mass, temperature, area, volume, digital data, energy, pressure, speed, time, and other scientific and everyday measurement systems. All calculations execute locally in the user's browser with zero tracking, zero advertising cookies, and zero server-side telemetry.

Canonical Origin: https://converter.numanxstudio.com/
Publisher: NumanX Studio
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
XML Sitemap: https://converter.numanxstudio.com/sitemap.xml
Full Agent Documentation: https://converter.numanxstudio.com/llms-full.txt

## Category Landings

- [Length](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/length): Meters, feet, inches, centimeters, kilometers, miles, yards, millimeters, nautical miles, micrometers, nanometers.
- [Area](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/area): Square meters, square feet, acres, hectares, square kilometers, square miles.
- [Volume](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/volume): Liters, milliliters, gallons, cubic meters, cubic feet, fluid ounces, cups.
- [Mass & Weight](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/mass): Kilograms, grams, pounds, ounces, metric tons, milligrams, stones, carats.
- [Temperature](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/temp): Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Rankine with exact affine zero-offset formulas.
- [Time](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/time): Seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years, milliseconds, microseconds.
- [Speed](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/speed): Meters per second, kilometers per hour, miles per hour, knots, feet per second.
- [Acceleration](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/acceleration): Meters per second squared, standard gravity (g), feet per second squared, gal.
- [Force](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/force): Newtons, kilonewtons, pound-force, dyne, kilogram-force.
- [Pressure](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/pressure): Pascals, bars, PSI, atmospheres, millimeters of mercury, kilopascals.
- [Energy](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/energy): Joules, calories, kilowatt-hours, British thermal units (BTU), electronvolts.
- [Power](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/power): Watts, kilowatts, horsepower, megawatts, gigawatts.
- [Electricity & Current](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/electricity): Amperes, milliamperes, kiloamperes, microamperes, coulombs, volts, ohms, farads.
- [Magnetism](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/magnetism): Tesla, gauss, weber, maxwell.
- [Frequency](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/frequency): Hertz, kilohertz, megahertz, gigahertz, revolutions per minute.
- [Digital Storage](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/data): Bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes, kibibytes, mebibytes, gibibytes (decimal vs binary prefixes).
- [Data Transfer Rate](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/datatransfer): Bits per second, megabits per second, gigabits per second, megabytes per second.
- [Angle](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/angle): Degrees, radians, gradians, arcminutes, arcseconds.
- [Torque](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/torque): Newton-meters, pound-feet, pound-inches.
- [Fuel Economy](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/fuel): Miles per gallon (US), liters per 100 km, kilometers per liter.
- [Density](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/density): Kilograms per cubic meter, grams per cubic centimeter, pounds per cubic foot.
- [Cooking](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/cooking): Cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, fluid ounces, milliliters, grams (ingredient-aware).
- [Textile & Yarn Count](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/textile): Tex, denier, cotton count (Ne), worsted count, metric count (Nm), oz/yd², and momme.
- [Astronomy](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/astronomy): Astronomical units (au), light-years, parsecs, kilometers, miles.
- [Number Base & Radix](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/number-base): Binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal, BCD, Gray code, and two's complement.
- [IEEE-754 Floating-Point](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/ieee-754): Half (FP16), single (FP32), double (FP64), and hexadecimal float bitfield inspection.
- [South Asian Numbering](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/pk-numbering): Hazar, Lakh, Crore, Arab, Kharab, and Million/Billion 2,2,3 grouping.
- [Statistics & Odds](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/statistics): Z-score, percentiles, two-tailed p-values, decimal odds, fractional odds, and American moneyline.
- [Matrix & Array Formats](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/matrix-format): CSV grids, LaTeX bmatrix/pmatrix, Python NumPy, MATLAB, and JSON 2D arrays.
- [Scientific & Parts-Per](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/scientific-notation): Standard decimal, engineering notation, ppm, ppb, and percentages.
- [HEC GPA & Marks](https://converter.numanxstudio.com/convert/pk-gpa): Pakistani HEC 4.00/5.00 CGPA, percentage marks, matric/FSc, and MDCAT aggregate.

## Machine Usage & Agent Guidelines

- Nature of this File: `llms.txt` is an emerging community convention and proposal for providing concise, LLM-oriented site documentation. It is not a formal web standard and carries no guarantee of crawler ingestion, AI discovery, ranking benefit, or model citation.
- URL Structure: All public routes follow deterministic paths: `/convert/{category}` for category landings and `/convert/{category}/{from}-to-{to}` for unit pairs.
- Scientific Grounding: Conversion factors follow the BIPM SI Brochure (9th Edition) and NIST Special Publication 811.
- No Commercial Endorsement: Institutional references (NIST, BIPM, ISO, IEC, CODATA, WMO) represent scientific source provenance only and do not imply institutional endorsement.
- Privacy & State: The application runs entirely on the client. Routes such as `/history`, `/favorites`, `/settings`, `/custom-units`, `/help`, and `/dashboard` rely on browser LocalStorage, are tagged noindex, and are not public indexable URLs.
